rationale: Static verification: independently recomputed the source digest using the manifest recipe and all six listed per-file SHA-256 values match; the resulting digest matches source_sha256. Independently hashed all four materialised reviewed tests and their hashes match the manifest. The gradient suite exercises production hyperbolic operators and the residual quantizer; the math suite uses closed-form numerical references rather than implementation-derived expected values; the DDP suite spawns two real ranks, all-gathers distinct local values, gradients, and post-step parameters; and the entrypoint suite calls trainer.main(), observes the real compute_loss path, then checks checkpoint and SID exports. However, the reviewed math test resolves its candidate path as Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5] / "stage2_RQ-VAE" / ... . From the stated materialised test path, parents[5] is the results directory, so it looks for results/stage2_RQ-VAE/... rather than the candidate under the workspace root. This makes the test unable to load the candidate in the designated reviewed location and is a static path defect. Suites were not executed here; execution proof is still required from verification_check, which must run all four with the Stage2 interpreter and require nonzero tests with no skips or failures. Fix the math-test source resolution, then regenerate/verify its hash before approval.
